newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends little changed on calm market.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends little changed on calm market.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 274-276 per dollar, almost unchanged from 273-275 in the morning, with help from the central bank amid a calm interbank trade, dealers said.
"Foreign currency demand was low and supply was large enough to cover it in calm trade," a commercial bank dealer said.
Part of the supply came from the central bank, which sold small amounts of dollars from 273 levs in the morning to 274.50 in the afternoon, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
